name: Carvolix SA
summary: Carvolix SA, a medical technology company, develops and markets minimally invasive, minimally invasive medical devices in the field of urology and structural heart in France. It offers Artus, an implantable electro-mechanical artificial sphincter that targets moderate to severe urinary incontinence; and Kalios and Epygon implants for the treatment of mitral insufficiency, as well as Kardiozis technology for treating abdominal aortic aneurysm.
